name: Genestealer Patriarch

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 4 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Living Idol
bonuses.text: Any Threats with GENESTEALER CULT within 10 metres gain +2 bonus dice to all Tests.

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (p.133).

abilities.name: Swift & Deadly
abilities.text: The Threat Seizes the Initiative without spending a point of Ruin and Charges. It gains an additional +1 bonus die to its attack Test as part of the Charge.
The Genestealer Patriarch may use its Broodmind and Monstrous Rending Claws without suffering the -2DN Multi-Action penalty.

abilities.name: Broodmind
abilities.text: The Genestealer Patriarch may attempt to activate any of the following psychic powers: Smite p.272, Psyniscience p.267, Deny the Witch p.267, Compel p.268, Fog the Mind p.279, Psychic Shriek p.279, Terrify p.280.

abilities.name: Broodmind
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Genestealer Patriarch attempts to activate a Psychic Power or Deny the Witch (p.267).

determination: Lightning Reflexes: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 8d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
